HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

   C. Apply the teaching of Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7. to insult classmates of other faiths.

   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
